symptom: Repair v5 passed the 300s / 3-seed small matrix, but failed the 300s / 10-seed expansion. IdleBot and RandomBot stayed at 0.0%, TankBot stayed in range at 40.0%, and BossHunterBot stayed in range at 70.0%. CowardBot rose to 60.0%, GreedyXpBot rose to 60.0%, KiteBot rose to 90.0%, ZoneControlBot dropped to 20.0%, and RouteBot rose to 40.0%, so the candidate is not promotable.
root_cause: The v5 210-300s ranged pressure was enough to make the 3-seed probe look healthy but not enough across wider seeds. Safe movement and mobility-biased builds still avoid or outgrow most midgame pressure, while ZoneControlBot does not gain enough control payoff from caramel / sour control weapons to stay inside the mid-skill target band.
fix: Keep v5 as a failed repair candidate and create a v6 patch. The v6 direction should increase readable 210-300s anti-kite pressure, mildly reduce mobility-overperformance, and improve the ZoneControl-specific control payoff without broadly nerfing starter weapons or lowering Harness gates.
validation: Rerun frosting-grassland 300s all-Bot matrices after v6. A viable repair must pass the 3-seed smoke matrix and then stay inside target bands on the 10-seed expansion before Replay regression, design review, manual playtest, final acceptance, or accepted content lockfile work.
